Refactor complete. I replaced the single misnamed source file with a focused tree implementation in [RedBlackTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTree.java:4) and moved the demo entry point to [RedBlackTreeDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeDemo.java:1). Internals are now encapsulated (`Node`, `Color`, insertion state), the old tree-level rotation flags are scoped per insert, and traversal/printing/validation are split into clearer helpers. I also added regression coverage in [RedBlackTreeTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeTest.java:7).

Verified with `javac RedBlackTree.java RedBlackTreeDemo.java RedBlackTreeTest.java -cp lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar && java -jar lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar execute --class-path . --scan-class-path`; all 3 tests pass. One inherited limitation remains: duplicate-key insertion is still undefined and should be treated as unsupported unless you want that behavior specified next.
